start:
Hi, {name}.

This is a botkit starter. Try /feedback to see a multi-step form, or /language to switch languages.

/help — everything this bot does
start.admin_hint: You have admin rights here. /admin opens the panel.
help: Commands /start — begin again /feedback — send feedback /language — change language /cancel — leave whatever you are in the middle of /help — this message
help.admin: Admin /admin — panel /stats — user counts /broadcast — message everyone /promote <id> <role> — change a role (owner only)
error: Something went wrong. It has been logged — try again in a moment.
throttled: That is a little too fast. Give it a second.
category.question: Question
feedback.too_short: That is a bit short. At least {min} characters, please.
feedback.too_long: That is too long — keep it under {max} characters.
feedback.unknown_category: That category no longer exists. Start again with /feedback.
admin.stats.title: Users
admin.broadcast.prompt: Send me the message to broadcast, or /cancel.
admin.promote.bad_id: That is not a valid user id.
admin.promote.owner_is_config: Owners are set in configuration, not here.
admin.promote.unknown_user: No such user — they have to talk to the bot first.
